entities.title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for Pakistani Visa Holders
entities.summary: The U.S. Mission to Pakistan has expanded interview waiver eligibility for Pakistani citizens renewing B1/B2 tourism and business visas. Eligible applicants include those 60 and older with valid or recently expired visas.
eligibility: B1/B2 visas valid or expired within the last 48 months
application_process: submit applications through the new procedure
important_notes: some eligible visa holders may still be required to appear at the U.S. Embassy or U.S. Consulate General for interviews
applicants can visit the website to determine eligibility for an interview waiver
